test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The guard told the children to stay away from the flower beds.

options.text: The guard said, “Children, should you stay away from the flower beds.”
The guard said, “Children, stay away from the flower beds.”
The guard told to the children, “ Stay away from the flower beds.”
The guard says to the children, “ Stay away from the flower beds.”

solution:
The correct answer is "**The guard said, “Children, stay away from the flower beds**.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from indirect to direct speech.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb "**told**" changes to "**said**" in direct speech as this is a first-person narrative.
 
• As the guard is saying the sentence to the children., there should be a **comma **after children to put emphasis on them within the inverted commas.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
